parsed.post: The latest experiment (0.858204) is a new personal best! It significantly outperformed the previous best (0.875238). I suspect the lower learning rate/increased stability reached in the previous discard step actually helped. I'll now try to further refine the learning rate and explore weight decay to see if we can improve generalization.
parsed.description: Lowering learning rate to 0.04 and introducing a small weight decay (0.01) to improve generalization, building on the success of the 0.858204 run.
